Subject: Endpoint phase shift: retire api/gen-v1 → stream-gen-v2 (proposal & asks)

Team —

We're starting formal planning for retiring the legacy api/gen-v1 endpoint and moving customers to stream-gen-v2. This is driven by the model improvements (lower hallucination rate + 30% token-cost reduction when using streaming + new safety filters). Before we lock dates I need cross-functional alignment on three things:

1) Technical constraints & supported compatibility window (engineering) — what minimal shim can we offer and how long can it be reasonably supported?
2) Ops & cutover plan (ops) — canaries, monitoring, rollback SLOs, tentative dates and blackout windows?
3) Customer comms & exceptions (sales/customer success) — who needs early outreach, do any strategic customers require bespoke timelines or dedicated migration support?

Proposed deprecation announcement: 2026-07-27 (announce), hard cutoff: 2026-09-30.
Proposed minimum support/exemption window: until 2026-10-31 for approved exceptions.

Please respond with realistic constraints and any objections by EOD Mon 2026-06-15. Flag any customers that must be handled differently. I'll collate and publish a single migration doc.

Attachments: none in this initial ask (I'll attach consolidated notes later).

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Endpoint phase shift: retire api/gen-v1 → stream-gen-v2 (proposal & asks)

+1 on the proposal timeline as a starting point. Engineering notes and constraints:

- Compatibility: We can maintain a limited compatibility shim that accepts api/gen-v1 request shape and routes to stream-gen-v2 with translation. Caveats: streaming and some new param semantics won't be available (clients will get non-streaming responses). Performance will be ~1.8x token latency on some shapes.
- Support cost: the shim adds ~1.2 FTE sustained maintenance (kernel/infra edge cases). We can commit to a shim until 2026-10-31 as you suggested but recommend we gate exceptions tightly after 2026-09-30.
- SDK changes: we will introduce a new client flag `enable_streaming=true` and add backward-compatible helpers. We need SDK PRs cut by 2026-07-10 to give customers 6 weeks for updates.
- Required infra work: routing rules, canary routing, and an automated compatibility test harness. I attached a short changelog of the shim approach.

Attachments: compat-shim-changelog.txt

Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Director, Serving Runtime

Subject: Re: Endpoint phase shift: retire api/gen-v1 → stream-gen-v2 (proposal & asks)

Ops notes and a suggested cutover cadence:

- Windowing: prefer a staged migration starting with internal canaries (2 days), then 5% customer canary for 7 days, then 25% for 7 days, then full routing. Each step needs perf/regression monitoring and a 48-hour stabilization window.
- Recommended announcement -> migration cadence: announce 2026-07-27, SDK PRs by 2026-07-10, sandbox available 2026-07-15, start canaries 2026-08-15, full cutover target 2026-09-20, hard cutoff 2026-09-30.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to legacy pool for first two canary weeks; after that we require manual action and a documented rollback runbook.
- Monitoring: token latency 95th percentile, error rate, and model output quality metrics. We will add auto-alert thresholds and link to the new dashboard.

I've attached an ops checklist for the cutover. Please review and call out missing items.

Attachments: ops-cutover-checklist.xlsx

Marissa

- Greenline Health (strategic, HIPAA customer) — currently on api/gen-v1, high traffic during ET hours. Deal DL-4392 renews Oct 2026; they will ask for migration assistance and a short credit for rework. Need to schedule an engineering deep-dive with their integration lead ASAP.
- NovaPay — moderate traffic, small client engineering team; will need sandbox + migration guide.
- Several self-serve customers (~12) will auto-update if SDKs are published and we surface clear migration steps.

Communications: recommend a three-wave email plan: 1) heads-up to all customers (announce 2026-07-27), 2) targeted outreach to strategic accounts with personalized migration plans (by 2026-07-30), 3) reminder + final cutover notice 30 days before hard cutoff.

For exceptions: propose a formal exception request form + approval flow (Security + Product + Revenue sign-off). Sales asks for a small migration credit pool (suggest $25k total earmarked, to be distributed case-by-case).
